reason: The hypothesis directly restates the well-established mechanism of passive film rupture and repassivation under mechanical action, already described in detail for cavitation erosion-corrosion (P2, P5, P6, P28) and tribocorrosion (P8), and applies it to sliding wear on a commonly studied alloy (CoCrFeMnNi) in a standard test environment. The proposed test, measurements, and falsification rule are taken from existing tribocorrosion protocols (P8, P14). The idea of boron addition to improve passive film stability is also directly from P7, P11, P12, and P16. No new combination, transfer, or mechanism is introduced.
